item: R101: quarantined articles leave the keyword figures, the language series and the equilibrium lever
key_paths: src/analytics/quarantine_scope.py; src/analytics/store.py; src/analytics/quarantine_job.py; src/analytics/columnar.py; src/analytics/queries.py; src/analytics/supergroup_rising.py; src/analytics/supergroup_stats.py; src/database/snapshots.py; src/scheduler/equilibrium.py; src/backup/merge.py; tests/test_quarantine_leaves_keyword_figures.py; tests/test_quarantine_carry.py
summary: One slice per R101 (PRH-06/D22): one filter (quarantine_scope.not_quarantined, an index-only NOT IN on idx_article_quarantined) shared by the keyword counters (index_article skips a quarantined article; the job's stamp subtracts its mentions in the same commit and bumps the corpus epoch; reconcile/backfill filter), the keyword_daily rollup build and tail refresh and their parity probe, every live fallback that stands in for the rollup (top_terms, trending, trend, the supergroup sums), the restore carry delta, article_counts_by_language and corpus_language_shares. furniture_share measured first: unchanged (the qualification path already drops quarantined ids and never reads these aggregates). Cost on a 1M-mention synthetic corpus, 10% quarantined: same plans, windowed read +13%, a 5k-keyword reconcile slice 23 to 45 ms. 10 of 14 new tests red on main. Not in scope and still counting quarantined articles: other per-article-set mention readers (keyword_growth, bulletin coverage, the maintenance one-time counter backfill, which the next reconcile repairs); the signed evidence export is excluded by the ruling.
